_readme.purpose: Rain-gauge sites for the VARUNA MUM-2019-07-02 replay bundle. Synthetic gauge readings are sampled from the truth rain field at these locations; the locations themselves are real and sourced.
_readme.rules: Per SPEC.md 0.7: every entry carries a source_url. 'verified' is true ONLY when lon/lat were read from a source (IMD/NOAA station metadata, OpenStreetMap, or Nominatim). No coordinate in this file was estimated, rounded from a locality centroid, or guessed. Stations with no published coordinate carry lon/lat null and verified false, with 'candidate' naming what exists but could not be matched unambiguously.
_readme.station_roster_source: The BMC / IMD / IITM gauge names, operators and platform_station_id values come from the station picker of the IIT Bombay 'Mumbai Rain' platform (116 stations), source_url https://www.mumbairain.org/ , cached docs/research/_raw/iitm_mumbairain.html . That platform publishes names and ids but no coordinates.
_readme.bmc_coordinate_gap: The BMC/MCGM disaster-management portal exposes https://dmwebtwo.mcgm.gov.in/api/location/loadActiveAWSLocations , which very likely holds the official BMC AWS coordinates, but it is POST-only (HTTP 405 on GET, checked 2026-09-05 and again 2026-09-06; see docs/research/_raw/dm_api_reports_getWeatherStationSuburbZoneWardFromStationType.json). Until that is retrieved, BMC gauge siting is INFERRED from the OpenStreetMap position of the host facility and must be labelled 'inferred' in the UI.
_readme.aoi: MUM-CENTRAL = lon 72.815-72.905, lat 18.995-19.135 (WGS84). 'in_aoi' is computed from lon/lat where known.

stations.name: IMD Mumbai-Santacruz observatory
stations.note: NOAA ISD row: "430030","99999","CHHATRAPATI SHIVAJI MAHARAJ INTL","IN","","VABB","+19.089","+072.868","+0011.3". The Santacruz observatory sits at Mumbai airport; WMO/IMD id 43003 is confirmed as Mumbai-Santacruz by https://city.imd.gov.in/citywx/extreme.php?id=43003 (cached docs/research/_raw/imd_extreme_43003.html). This is the station that recorded 375.2 mm in the 24 h ending 08:30 IST on 2 Jul 2019. Coordinate precision is 3 decimals (~100 m) as published by ISD.

stations.name: IMD Mumbai-Colaba observatory (Regional Meteorological Centre)
stations.note: Nominatim display_name: 'Regional Meteorological Centre Mumbai, Nanabhai Moos Marg, Colaba, A Ward, ...'. Independently corroborated by NOAA ISD row "430570","99999","BOMBAY / COLABA","IN",...,"+18.900","+072.817","+0011.0" (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/noaa/isd-history.csv), which agrees to ~330 m. WMO/IMD id 43057 confirmed as Mumbai-Colaba by https://city.imd.gov.in/citywx/extreme.php?id=43057. Recorded 137.88 mm in the 24 h ending 08:30 IST on 2 Jul 2019. LIES OUTSIDE MUM-CENTRAL by ~11 km to the south - treat as an out-of-domain gauge or exclude from the bundle, and say which in the manifest.

stations.name: Haji Ali storm water pumping station
stations.note: OSM name 'Storm Water Pumping Station - Haji Ali', man_made=water_works. Unambiguous name match to the platform gauge. Coordinate is the facility centroid, not a surveyed gauge mast. Just south of the AOI (lat 18.979 < 18.995).

stations.name: Colaba pumping station
stations.note: OSM name 'Colaba Pumping Station', tagged man_made=wastewater_plant - the tag says sewage, the platform gauge says 'pumping station'; same name, very likely the same compound, but the tag mismatch is recorded here rather than hidden. Outside the AOI.

stations.name: F North ward office (Matunga / Sion / Wadala)
stations.note: OSM name 'F/N BMC Ward Office'. This is the ward that contains King's Circle, Gandhi Market, Sion Circle and Wadala - the densest part of the hotspot register - so this gauge matters most to the demo.

stations.name: G South ward office (Worli / Lower Parel)
stations.note: OSM name 'BMC G South Ward Office', office=government.

stations.name: L ward office (Kurla)
stations.note: OSM name 'BMC L Ward Office'. L ward covers Kurla and LBS Marg, one of the AOI hotspots, and the Kurla-Thane belt reported 183 mm in 3 h overnight on 1-2 Jul 2019.

stations.name: Andheri fire station

stations.name: Chembur fire station
